projects.name: Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
An analytics dashboard project delivering three core capabilities: (1) an ingestion/processing pipeline for customer CSV files, (2) log analysis over application logs, and (3) interactive visualization components. The project is organized into milestones so every executable leaf task stays at a manageable complexity level (<= 6/10), enabling incremental delivery and clear ownership.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-pipeline, csv, log-analysis, visualization

tasks.name: M1 — Project Setup & Requirements Definition
tasks.details: Milestone: establish scope, success metrics, data contracts, and the working environment. Deliverables include an approved requirements spec, defined KPIs, CSV and log schema contracts, and a ready repository/tooling baseline. This is a container milestone; execution is tracked through its subtasks.

tasks.name: M2 — Customer CSV Ingestion & Processing Pipeline
tasks.details: Milestone: ingest customer CSV files reliably, validate and clean records, handle schema drift and bad rows, and produce normalized customer datasets for analytics. This is a container milestone; execution is tracked through its subtasks.

tasks.name: M3 — Application Log Analysis Pipeline
tasks.details: Milestone: parse application logs, normalize event fields, detect errors and anomalies, and generate log-derived metrics (error rates, latency, top failure reasons). This is a container milestone; execution is tracked through its subtasks.

tasks.name: M4 — Data Modeling, Storage & Aggregation Layer
tasks.details: Milestone: define the analytics data model, provision storage, and build aggregation/serving queries that unify customer and log data for the dashboard. This is a container milestone; execution is tracked through its subtasks.

tasks.name: M5 — Visualization Components & Frontend
tasks.details: Milestone: build the reusable chart and widget components, dashboard layout, filters, and interaction states that render the customer and log analytics. This is a container milestone; execution is tracked through its subtasks.

tasks.name: M6 — Dashboard Integration, Testing & QA
tasks.details: Milestone: integrate pipelines with the dashboard, wire the API layer, and validate correctness, performance, and usability through automated and manual testing. This is a container milestone; execution is tracked through its subtasks.

tasks.name: M7 — Deployment, Monitoring & Documentation
tasks.details: Milestone: ship the dashboard to a hosted environment, set up scheduling/CI, monitoring and alerting, and complete user and operational documentation. This is a container milestone; execution is tracked through its subtasks.

tasks.name: Define dashboard goals, personas & success KPIs
tasks.details: Identify primary users (e.g., support ops, growth, engineering), the decisions they need to make, and 5–8 measurable KPIs for the dashboard. Output: one-page goals & KPI definition doc.

tasks.name: Specify customer CSV data contract
tasks.details: Document every CSV column: name, type, required/optional, formats, allowed values, PII flags, and example rows. Include expected file size, encoding, delimiter, and header conventions. Output: versioned CSV schema contract.

tasks.name: Specify application log format & event schema
tasks.details: Document log sources, formats (JSON/plaintext), fields (timestamp, level, service, request_id, latency_ms, message), timestamp formats/timezones, and retention. Output: versioned log event schema + 20 sample log lines.

tasks.name: Set up repository, environments & CI skeleton
tasks.details: Create the mono-repo structure (pipelines, api, web), language toolchains, linting/formatting, pre-commit hooks, and a minimal CI workflow that runs lint + tests. Output: working dev environment and green CI on main.

tasks.name: Consolidate requirements spec & obtain sign-off
tasks.details: Merge goals/KPIs, CSV contract, and log schema into a single requirements spec; review with stakeholders and record approval plus open questions. Output: signed-off v1 requirements spec.

tasks.name: Build CSV upload / landing mechanism
tasks.details: Implement a way to land incoming customer CSV files (local watch folder and/or object-storage upload) with idempotent naming, checksum dedupe, and a processing queue/trigger. Output: upload entrypoint + docs.

tasks.name: Implement CSV parsing & encoding handling
tasks.details: Parse CSV with configurable delimiter/quote/escape, detect and handle encodings (UTF-8 with/without BOM, Latin-1 fallback), support quoted multiline fields, and stream large files without loading fully into memory. Output: parser module + tests.

tasks.name: Implement schema validation & bad-row reporting
tasks.details: Validate each row against the CSV data contract (types, required fields, formats, ranges). Collect row-level errors with line numbers into a rejects file/report rather than failing the whole batch. Output: validation module + rejects report format.

tasks.name: Implement cleaning & normalization
tasks.details: Normalize dates to ISO-8601/UTC, trim and case-fold strings, coerce numerics, handle nulls/empty values, and de-duplicate records by stable key. Keep raw values available for audit. Output: transform module + before/after examples.

tasks.name: Handle CSV schema drift & versioning
tasks.details: Detect added/removed/renamed columns, map known aliases, and reject unknown major versions with a clear message. Support at least the current and previous contract versions. Output: version resolver + mapping config.

tasks.name: Write CSV pipeline tests & fixtures
tasks.details: Create fixture CSVs covering happy path, encoding edge cases, malformed rows, duplicates, and schema drift. Add unit + integration tests achieving meaningful coverage of parser, validator, and transforms. Output: test suite green in CI.

tasks.name: Add CSV pipeline observability
tasks.details: Emit structured run metrics: files processed, rows read, rows accepted/rejected, durations, and error reasons. Log a run summary and expose counts for later monitoring. Output: metrics/logging hooks + sample run report.

tasks.name: Configure log ingestion from files/stream
tasks.details: Connect to application log sources (rotated local files and/or a stream/log shipper) with incremental read positions, backfill support, and idempotent reprocessing. Output: ingestion config + checkpointing.

tasks.name: Implement JSON log parser
tasks.details: Parse structured JSON log lines into typed events: handle nested fields, escaped characters, and invalid JSON (skip and count rather than crash). Output: JSON parser module + unit tests.

tasks.name: Normalize log event fields
tasks.details: Standardize timestamps to UTC, map log levels to a canonical set, extract service/environment, request IDs, HTTP status, and latency. Validate required fields and quarantine malformed events. Output: normalized event schema implementation.

tasks.name: Compute error-rate & latency metrics
tasks.details: Aggregate per service/endpoint/time-bucket: request counts, error counts and rates, p50/p95/p99 latency, and throughput. Output: metric computation jobs + verified sample outputs.

tasks.name: Aggregate top error signatures & failure reasons
tasks.details: Group errors by normalized message/error code/stack signature, rank by frequency and impact, and attribute to service and release. Output: top-errors table + aggregation job.

tasks.name: Implement anomaly detection for log metrics
tasks.details: Add simple, explainable anomaly rules (error-rate spikes vs rolling baseline, latency regression, error-burst detection) with configurable thresholds and suppress-noise windows. Output: anomaly rules + alert events.

tasks.name: Write log pipeline tests & sample-log fixtures
tasks.details: Create fixtures for JSON logs, plaintext logs, multiline stack traces, malformed lines, and mixed timezones. Add unit + integration tests for parsing, normalization, and metric computation. Output: test suite green in CI.

tasks.name: Design analytics data model
tasks.details: Model facts and dimensions for customer and log data (e.g., fact_customer_activity, fact_log_events, dim_customer, dim_service, dim_date). Define grain, keys, SCD strategy, and naming conventions. Output: ERD + column dictionary.

tasks.name: Provision database/storage & migrations
tasks.details: Set up the analytics database (or warehouse) in dev/prod, implement versioned migrations for all tables, and seed reference data (dim_date, service catalog). Output: migration set + connection config.

tasks.name: Implement loaders & idempotent upserts
tasks.details: Load processed CSV and log outputs into the model with idempotent upserts keyed on natural keys, transactional batch writes, and late-arriving data handling. Output: loader modules + reload test.

tasks.name: Build aggregation & rollup queries
tasks.details: Implement daily/weekly rollups for customer metrics and log KPIs, with materialized views or scheduled aggregation tables for dashboard speed. Output: rollup jobs + benchmarked query times.

tasks.name: Build API endpoints for dashboard data
tasks.details: Expose read-only REST endpoints (or GraphQL) for each dashboard widget: KPI summaries, time series, top errors, customer segments. Include pagination, date-range filters, auth hook, and response caching. Output: documented API + contract tests.

tasks.name: Add data quality checks & reconciliation
tasks.details: Implement row-count reconciliation between source and warehouse, null/uniqueness/freshness checks, and a daily data-quality report. Output: DQ checks + pass/fail summary.

tasks.name: Scaffold frontend app, routing & design tokens
tasks.details: Initialize the web app framework, folder structure, routing, theme/design tokens (colors, spacing, typography), and shared layout shell. Output: running app shell with navigation and Storybook or component preview.

tasks.name: Build chart component library (line/bar/pie)
tasks.details: Create reusable, themeable line, bar, stacked-bar, and pie/donut chart wrappers with tooltips, legends, axis formatting, and responsive sizing. Output: documented chart components + visual examples.

tasks.name: Build KPI stat cards & data table components
tasks.details: Build stat/KPI cards with value, trend/delta and sparkline slots, plus a sortable, paginated data table for top errors and customer lists. Output: reusable components with props documented.

tasks.name: Build dashboard layout & responsive grid
tasks.details: Assemble the dashboard page layout: header, filter bar region, KPI row, chart grid, and table section. Ensure responsive breakpoints for laptop/tablet. Output: composed dashboard page wired to mock data.

tasks.name: Implement global filters (date, segment, service)
tasks.details: Add a shared filter state (date range presets + custom, customer segment, service/environment) propagated to all widgets via URL params for shareable views. Output: filter bar + state management.

tasks.name: Implement loading, empty & error states
tasks.details: Add skeleton loaders, empty-state messaging, and retryable error boundaries for every widget so slow or failed API calls degrade gracefully. Output: state components + demo toggles.

tasks.name: Accessibility pass (keyboard, contrast, ARIA)
tasks.details: Audit the dashboard for keyboard navigation, focus order, color contrast, ARIA labels on charts/tables, and screen-reader-friendly summaries. Output: accessibility checklist + fixes.

tasks.name: Wire dashboard to API with data fetching & caching
tasks.details: Replace mock data with real API calls per widget, implement request de-duplication/caching, refetch on filter change, and global error handling. Output: live-data dashboard in staging.

tasks.name: Integrate CSV pipeline end-to-end
tasks.details: Run a real customer CSV through upload → validation → cleaning → load → aggregation → API, and verify totals reconcile at each stage. Output: integration test + sample dataset report.

tasks.name: Integrate log pipeline end-to-end
tasks.details: Run sample application logs through ingestion → parsing → normalization → metrics → API, and verify error-rate and latency figures against hand-computed expectations. Output: integration test + verification report.

tasks.name: Build automated unit & integration test suite
tasks.details: Create the overarching test suite: unit tests for modules, integration tests across stages, API contract tests, and component tests for widgets. Enforce coverage thresholds in CI. Output: green CI test run + coverage report.

tasks.name: Performance & load testing with query optimization
tasks.details: Load-test API endpoints and dashboard rendering with realistic volumes (large CSVs, high log cardinality). Profile slow queries, add indexes/materializations, and set latency budgets. Output: performance report + optimizations applied.

tasks.name: Run UAT with stakeholders & triage bugs
tasks.details: Facilitate user acceptance testing against the KPI definitions and key user journeys. Capture feedback, log defects with severity, and confirm fixes. Output: UAT sign-off + prioritized defect log.

tasks.name: Security review (PII, auth & data access)
tasks.details: Classify PII in customer CSVs, apply masking/tokenization where required, verify dashboard authentication/authorization and API access controls, and scan dependencies for vulnerabilities. Output: security review + remediation list.

tasks.name: Build CI/CD pipeline & automated deploy
tasks.details: Extend CI to build/test all components, run migrations, and deploy API and web to staging then production with approvals and rollback. Output: working deployment pipeline.

tasks.name: Provision production hosting, database & object storage
tasks.details: Provision production hosting for the API and web app, a managed database/warehouse, and object storage for CSV/log files, with environment-specific sizing and networking. Output: infra-as-code + environment matrix.

tasks.name: Schedule pipeline jobs (cron/orchestrator)
tasks.details: Schedule CSV ingestion, log processing, rollups, and data-quality checks on a reliable cadence with retries, timeouts, and dependency ordering. Output: scheduler/orchestrator configs + run history.

tasks.name: Set up monitoring, alerting & pipeline health dashboards
tasks.details: Configure uptime checks, job failure/success alerts, data-freshness alarms, and a small operational health dashboard. Define on-call escalation. Output: alert rules + health dashboard.

tasks.name: Write user guide & operational runbook
tasks.details: Document dashboard usage (metrics meaning, filters), data refresh cadence, and an ops runbook for common failures (failed job, bad CSV, stale data) with recovery steps. Output: user guide + runbook.

tasks.name: Post-launch smoke test & handover
tasks.details: Run production smoke checks (login, all widgets load, fresh data, alerts firing correctly), confirm monitoring is green for 24h, and hand over to the owning team. Output: go-live checklist + handover sign-off.

tasks.name: Implement plaintext log parser & multiline handling
tasks.details: Extract fields from plaintext logs using configurable regex patterns, stitch multiline stack traces into single events, and count/quarantine unparseable lines. Output: plaintext parser module + tests.

tasks.name: Configure secrets management & environment variables
tasks.details: Store database, storage, and API credentials in a secrets manager, define per-environment variables, and document rotation. Output: secrets config + environment variable reference.
